name: A Friend in the Funny Business
source:
Out of the blue, you receive a text message from your coworker who resigned two years ago to follow other opportunities. She wants to reconnect with you! Can you carve out a little time to visit Al's Diner and meet with her this Saturday?

[From [url=https://aimvtuber.itch.io/a-friend-in-the-funny-business]itch.io[/url]]
